brand_architecture: MobileNetV3 Small, own avg/max pooled 18-brand head, regional fine-tuning, mirrored-view probability mean and development temperature
detector: Generic Faster R-CNN ResNet50 FPN v2 COCO, min800/max1333; default whole frame, optional tiles
general_initialization: General ImageNet/COCO explicitly authorized; no ready-made car-brand/vehicle-colour classifier
colour: Собственные обученные цветовые головы: полная вырезка и участки кузова; веса видов выбраны по development. Готовые vehicle-colour classifiers не используются.
brand_scope: 13 brands represented in this Stanford benchmark; human annotated crops, not full-scene/unknown-brand accuracy
